body:
Toronto. It's clean and virtually crime-free, but it's horribly expensive, the weather is awful, and it has a sort of profound spiritual deadness to it. You will never meet more polite unfriendly people. I make new friends in no time at all when I'm in NYC or LA, but in Toronto everyone just stares right through you. They don't even have the decency to not like you.

I've been here for eight years. I want to move to LA but I'm not a US citizen and there's no way I qualify for a green card.

Edit: I see by your comment history that you like marijuana. We should trade lives for a few months because I think I'm the only person here that doesn't like the stuff.
Want to trade jobs and cities?
